note: The P1-T7 live check, with a deliberately bogus COHERE_API_KEY. LiteLLM's _map_cohere_exception has no 401 branch, so this arrives as APIConnectionError with a synthetic status 500 rather than as AuthenticationError. The type table alone yields server_error; D7 counts that toward the breaker and excludes auth_failure, so unrefined this trips the Phase 3 breaker on a healthy provider. This fixture is the bug P2-T1 exists to fix. NOTE: 'message' below is the INNER message - LiteLLM prepends 'litellm.APIConnectionError: ' itself.

kwargs.message: CohereException - {"message":"Incorrect API key provided: sk-***. You can find your API key at https://dashboard.cohere.com/api-keys."}
